title: Aggregate Sales Activities, Customer 360 and Customer Enrichment contributions
objective: Complete repository step 12 with the final behavior-neutral owner batch: expose stable owner-owned production contribution entry points and exact inventory factories for Sales/Activities, Customer 360 and Customer Enrichment, merge them through crm-first-party-modules, relocate Customer Enrichment transactional reference guards out of the generic process host, and remove the remaining ordinary owner construction and registration bypasses from native composition while preserving exact inventories, activation, authorization, governed reads, persistence and worker behavior.
deliverables: Sales/Activities exposes exact mutation/query factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving the planner router and query cursor behavior

Customer 360 exposes its exact query factory and one activation-gated query-only production contribution builder from the existing query-owner boundary without changing projection ownership or workers
Customer Enrichment transactional mapping and Party reference guards move from crm-application-runtime into the existing owner composition crate without behavior changes

Customer Enrichment exposes exact mutation/query factories and one activation-gated production contribution builder preserving Party and Consent governed reads, immutable definition validation and three query adapter groups
crm-first-party-modules merges all remaining production owner contributions without repeated module identifiers or coordinates
generic application runtime retains only platform-level metadata, search and link-shell composition and no ordinary first-party owner construction
native composition guards reject renewed Sales/Activities, Customer 360 or Customer Enrichment direct wiring
Cargo.lock records only intentional internal path-edge changes and no package or external dependency version change
acceptance: public mutation/query coordinates, inventory contents and compatibility APIs preserve their existing order and meaning
tenant activation, visibility authorization, governed Party and Consent reads, transactional reference validation, persistence and worker behavior are unchanged
Sales/Activities, Customer 360 and Customer Enrichment ordinary construction or registration bypasses no longer appear in generic native composition
Customer Enrichment transactional reference guards no longer live in crm-application-runtime
first-party aggregate contains every active production owner contribution exactly once
workspace package count and external dependency families and versions are unchanged
repository step 12 implementation is complete and repository step 13 is not started
non_goals: start repository step 13 or any later architecture work
change product behavior, routes, coordinates, contracts, schemas, migrations, persistence, projections or workers
create, remove, rename or consolidate crates
change affected-scope policy or permanent workflows
change external dependency versions or add a dependency family
claim documentation evidence synchronization before this implementation batch is accepted and merged
